slides.headline: What does it mean?
slides.body: A franchise opportunity typically comes with a defined set-up cost, covered in the franchise disclosure documents, which can make finance planning more structured than for an independent start-up. Lenders may also factor in the franchisor's track record.

caption:
A franchise opportunity often comes with clearer, more structured costs than starting independently, which can make the finance conversation more straightforward — but it still deserves the same careful evaluation as any other significant business decision.

Reviewing the disclosure document thoroughly, alongside independent advice, is worth the time before committing.
